props.name: bodies
props.description: Starting bodies, in world units (the default view spans about seventy). Overrides `preset`.

props.name: preset
props.description: The arrangement to start from when `bodies` is not given. The scene picker changes it after.

props.name: gravity
props.description: The gravitational constant G. Presets are built for it, so their circular orbits stay circular.

props.name: softening
props.description: Plummer softening length ε in world units: how far gravity is smeared to avoid the r = 0 singularity.

props.name: collisions
props.description: Touching bodies merge (conserving mass and momentum), bounce elastically, or pass through.

props.name: trails
props.description: Fading trails: `true` for 20 units of simulated time, a number for that many, `false` for none.

props.name: timeScale
props.description: Simulated time per real second, relative to the default. The speed slider starts here.

props.name: paused
props.description: Controlled pause. Omit to let the play button own it.

props.name: onPausedChange
props.description: Called when the play button, the space key or the handle changes the pause state.

props.name: showVectors
props.description: Draw each body's velocity as an arrow.

props.name: showBarycentre
props.description: Mark the system's centre of mass. It should never move: momentum is conserved.

props.name: launchMass
props.description: Mass of a body launched by dragging or from the keyboard. The mass slider starts here.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the drawing. Without it the canvas is decorative and the status line carries the state.

props.name: controls
props.description: Show the transport, scene picker, switches and sliders.
